correction.name: Tanmay
correction.title: Changing your mind mid-sentence
correction.watch: The 3:30 alarm is planned while you pause, then held back when you correct yourself. It never runs; only 4:30 is set.

lines.say: No no, cancel that. Set it for 4:30 instead.
What alarms do I have now?

battery.name: Tanmay
battery.title: Troubleshooting you can interrupt
battery.watch: DUET reads the phone's battery, screen and app usage. You cut in with your own theory; it stops, checks it against the numbers, and changes a setting only when you ask.

lines.say: My battery has been draining really fast lately. What's going on?
Oh wait, I think I know. My brightness is always really high, and I play a lot of games. Is that it?
Yes please, bring the brightness down to forty percent.

apps.name: Tanmay
apps.title: Knowing your phone
apps.watch: DUET reads the installed apps and decides which ones are for shopping (Android has no shopping category).

lines.say: How many shopping apps do I have on my phone?

care.name: Ramesh
care.title: Care: never a double dose
care.watch: An older man living alone. DUET checks the medicine record before answering, refuses a second dose kindly, records how he feels, and calls his daughter when he asks.

lines.say: Did I take my blood pressure tablet today? I can't remember, so I'll just take one now.
Oh, thank you. I'm feeling a little tired today, but I'm fine.
Could you call my daughter, please?

drive.name: Tanmay
drive.title: Drive: route changes and the home from the car
drive.watch: Only the final destination is set. The text uses the real arrival time. Ten minutes out, DUET speaks first and offers to cool the house.

lines.say: Take me to the office. No wait, take me home, I'm done for the day.
And text Priya that I'll be home by the arrival time.
Yes please, set it to twenty-four degrees.
